question: mi waddi bingel am mudu biji nayi nyautolde hanne nyaluwa mi leli bingel on siroso wudenayan goddon amma bosaran gatimo de be waddi jokale on wuro be hi ti'an kofeti mira buti fude reto bosaru en gati shukale on mita yi fudere non wuti bo buti mi wadi yamdede bo ken dirabe mo an di bosaru nganya tibingel on jon bosaru don wui be meda hokku go bosaru on jibnen de be wi dun yahai yasi dun fija dun warta tun be wi be meda hokku go bosaru dun nikki sun kanjum wadi mi holi sai mi yahai waddugo bingel on nautorde ngam to bosaru dun ngati tukale on no wawi no wodi no bosaru dume hebata bingel go bosaru ngati bo dume wawi hiba futere wujjudum e buti dum nyau bana nyau bosaru wawi nasta der futere ko wawi wadugo bingel on sabbun ngati bosaru on si ko dume mi wawi wadugo ngam to nyaunata futere on dume jun nande e lekki hani hokka bingel on ngam hiba jam ko dume goddo mi wawi wadugo wala ko lekki mi wawi wadango futere den de bosare don ngati bingel
reference: Mi waddi bingel am mo dubi jenayi Nyaurdorde hanne ƴaloma. Mi lili bingel on siri sooda Naƴam goɗun amma bosaaru ngati mo. De ɓe waddi cukaley on wuro ɓe hecci am ko fayti , Mi raɓɓuti futtere to bosaaru ɗun ngati cukaley on,Mi tawi futtere non wujji bo ɓuuti.  Men waɗi ƴamde  dere keddiraɓe mo andi bosaaru nga ƴati bingel on. Joom bosaaru ɗun wi'i ɓe meeɗa hokkuko bosaaru on Njibinanɗe .Ɓe wi'i ɗun yaha yasi dun  fija ɗu warta tan. Ɓe wi'i ɓe meeɗa hokkuko bosaaru ɗun lekki sam. Kanjum waɗi  mi huli se mi yaawi wadduko bingel on Nyaurdorde, gan to bosaaru ɗun ngati cukaley on no wodi ƴau bosaaru . Ɗume  heɓɓata bingel ko bosaaru ngati bo?  Ɗume wawi heɓɓa  futtere wojju ɗun e ɓuutu ɗun? Nƴau bana ƴau bosaaru waawi nasta dere futere? Ko waawi waɗɗuko bingel on sabun ngati bosaaru on? Tii, ko ɗume mi waawi waɗɗuko ngan to nƴau nata futtere on? Ɗume Njibinanɗe e lekki haani hokka bingel on gan hebɓe Jam? Ko ɗume goɗɗum min waawi waɗɗuko wala ko lekki min waawi waɗɗanko futtere ɗen to bosaaru ɗun ngati ɓingel on?
model_answer: Bingel maa ngatti bosaru wawitiɗam (omphalite) ngonka ina waawi naatde e ƴiiƴam, waɗa rafi sepsis baawɗo warde ɓingel. Ɗum tooñaare laaɓndu; aɗa foti artude e ɓingel to asibiti ɓooyma ngam ɓe lootoo gaafe bosaru, mbaɗa antibiotik (injection) e ƴiiƴam. Woto fuɗɗoro huutoraade kala leɗɗe aada, nebam, malla ɓiɓɓe piirtuɗe e dow gaafe, ɗum ɓeydaa njeññina e hoɗre. To opitaal, ɓe mbaɗat kadi tetanus prophylaxis so tawii yumma mum heɓaani nyawndu nduu e reedu. Toppitaa ɓingel ngel e nokku laaɓɗo, ngoppuɗo gaafe ɓuuɓɗi, haa ɓe ngoppitaa safrude e asibiti haa timma.

question: dai bo je jodata hasari amin o huwa dowada kugal mako bo o wala nyawu yande fere wakkati o do yi wa o nane en e mako do mari hunde petel satinga hada o numi wala ko dume o nani wala ko dume o lari o nani dum fahim nyande fere fahim do wakkati o dillai o fuddi numugo be mai sosai o fuddi numugo de mai on ha en e nyaku wala nyamugo molana wamo amma babali mai o sati bo sali dillugo o fuddi tum bo labari je ingol robbe je mari dum ha'i ndi naddi sati je sali o yahi larugo likita o yidi o anda dume on dasi dum de dumi on o wadata hala mai mdejema mdejemako mi on dasata hunde mai ha'i en idi bo ko mi onje satinga ha'i en i'o nagansa mi on de bolora talara fahim ha'i en imai
reference:
Debbo je jodata ha sare amen, do huwa.
Do wada kuugal maako  boddum bo o wala yeiwu. Yende fera, waakati odo yiwa, o nane endi maako dou mari hunde petel satinga hader. O numi wala ko duma , o lori o nane dun fahen yende fera fahen do . Waakati do dellal, o fudi damugo be mai sosai, o fudi numugo dimai on ha endi maako. Wala nawa mo, amma balal mai do sati bo sali dellu go. O fudi num tugo labari je binkon robe je mari don ha endi mabe. Sati je sali,  o yeti larugo likita.  O kidi o anda dumi on dasi dum be dume on o wadata hala mai. Made jima: dumi on dasata hunde mai ha endi debbo? Koh dume o je satin ga  ha endi on na cancer? Dume on debbo lora ta lara fahim ha endi mai?
model_answer: Haala maa e maanaaji ɗi o holli ɗum ina hollita wonde ko ñawu ngu jowitii e ƴiiƴam walla ƴiye ɓalli (neurologique) walla ko saabiiɗo kulol e caɗeele ɓernde (psychosomatique). Ko wayi no Multiple Sclerosis walla Guillain-Barré Syndrome ina waawi wadde ɗum; ammaa tawa noon ko bonannde ɓalli ngam ŋakkeende vitamin kadi walaa. So o yahii to asibiti mawndi, o waɗanee ƴeewndo ƴiiƴam, scan MRI ngam anndude ko woni. Gila jooni, wallit mo e ñaamdu moƴƴu, fooftere, e umminiingo terɗe (physiotherapy) ina waawi moƴƴinde. So tawii ƴeewndo ngoo hollitaani ñawu goɗɗo, toppitagol hakkille (counselling) ina heewi yahrude e moƴƴere.

Ƴamnde arandere nde Nyautowo ƴami :  dume on wadi reedu naawurta non ha ma ƴiiƴam wurto e sembe?

model_answer: Su sukaaɗo on woodi damre e wuttule, fuɗɗoraade hokkude mo ndiyam ORS (damjidam) ko waɗi haɓɓaago heelɓere. Hokku mo kadi zinc tablet balɗe 10–14 ngam ustude sahaa damre nden e semmbiɗinaago ɓanndu. Jokku njangirde mo endam maa walla nyaamdu ɓuuɓndu, taa darnu nyaamdu sabo damre. So o wutti, hokku ORS seeɗa-seeɗa e koppi famɗi fahin, woto dartin. To suka o ɓeydi welde, gite ɗe nguutta nder, walla o waawaa yarde, nawu mo to nokkuure cellal nder yaawre.

question: jam ɓanɗu likita useni mi waɗi ɓingel am siɓɓiti ngam mi laari no fofata ɗon woni bana sautu henɗu ɗo sala babel petel ni ɗon bo bana goɗɗo ɗon fufa hunde bo daker o fofata mi hirliti bo balde tati jotta o ɗo ɗodda be jemma wakkati fere miɗo lara ɓerde mako ɗo nasta sossai lukka ɗo sossai bana sauto naftiri sembe mako o fofata milari bo o wala nyama bana ni to o nyamai fu sauto to nyamai fu sauto o nangi fofɗe mako seto o nangi fofɗe mako irin banni mai ɗon hokkata mo bone o ɗo kasa nyamugo boɗɗum balɗe tati jotta mi arti mi yari mo kemist petel ha fattude amin ɓe hokki mo lekki ɗojjugo ngam o ɗo ɗojja seɗɗa seɗɗa amma ɗojjugo mai hallai amma pat lekkiji o yari wala ko nafi mo fofugo mako bannin ni kuma har jotta o wawata nyamugo boɗɗum useni irin damuwa toi damata ɓingel am be fofugo mako ɗo bana hendu ɗo saala babel petum useni o handini hotona heɓa famta ko damatamo be kwaɗi ɓernde mako ɗo fatta jippa ɗo irin nyamdiji toi mi hokkata ɓingel ɗo ha saare hoyninamo heba o foofa boɗɗum ɗon irin lekkiji feere sibitinaa ko hundeji tan feere mataaki je hosata haɗo ɓingel ɗo
reference:
Jam bandu likita, useni mi waddi bingel am sibiti gam mi laari no o foofata, don woni bana sawtu hendu do saala babal petel ni, donbo bana goddo don fuufa hunde, be daker o foofata. Mi hirliti bo balde tati jotta odo dojja be jamma. Wakati fere mido lara berde mako do nasta sosai lugga, do fa’a do sosai bana saito naftiri sembe mako o foofata. Milaribo owala yaama banaane.
To o yammai fu saito onangi fofde mako. Irin bani mai don hokkatamo bone odo kasa yamugo boddum balle tati jotta. Mi arti mi yari mo chemist petel ha fattude amin, be hokkimo lekki dojjugo gam odo dojja sedda sedda, amma dojjugo mai hallai .
Amma pat lekkiji o yari wala ko nafimo.
Foofugo mako bannin ni, kuma harjotta o wawata yamugo boddum. Useni irin damuwa toidamata mingel am be foofugo mako do bana hendu do saala babel piitum?
Useni o haadini hooto na? Heba famta ko daamata mo be kwadi berde mako do fada jippa do?
Irin yaudigi toi mihokkata mingel do ha sare, hoininamo heba o foofa boddum?
Don irin lekkiji fere sibiti na ko hundeji tan fere mataaki je hosata hado bingel do?
model_answer: Jam baandu. Nyamdu henɗu (pneumoniya malla krup) waɗi ɓingel maa caɗeele fofugo, ngam o woodi sautu henɗu bana piibol, ɓernde nastata (sossai), o waawa nyamugo. Ɗum alamaaji kulɓiniiɗi baawɗi warde ɓingel so o heɓaay oksijen jaawɗum. Haa saare, jooɗninde mo dow e cuuɗde mo e ɓuuɓri kosam ina waawi ustad e tampere, ammaa ñawu ngu waawaa yamde tan. Neldu ɓingel maa haa asibiti mawɗo ɗo ɓe mbaawi hokkude mo oksijen, nebuliser (lekki udditirta henɗu) e antibiyotik so ina haani. Woto hokku lekkiji soodaaɗi e kemist, ɗi mbaawi waɗde ko bonnata; ballal cellal tan hisnata ɗum.

question: dada debboje danye nebai wari sibiti o bi tun bingel mako danye o dauta rufe iyam sosai kanjum wadi o wala sembe ha bandu mako den bo mo danyi mai dubi mago nogas e nayi o bi bo rufugo iyam mai dudi masin danta bo wata mo o wala sembe dada mai kasi yamugo be kuma kasi wadugo ko ɗume dembe am kanjum dume on waddata debbo dinga rufugo iyam ɗo bawo danyi balɗe seɗɗa sali ɗum nyaudiiku toy ɓe hokkata dada mai jey rufugo iyam may darata den bo o lorna sembe mako shawara toy hokkata dada may ɓe ɓingel mako am
reference:
Dada debbo je dayi nebai wari sibiti . Ovi tun bingel mako dayi odota rufa eyam sosai.
Kanjum wadi owala sembe ha bandu mako.
Debbo mo dayi mai dubi mako nogas e ni. Ovi bo rufugo eyam mai duudi masin denta bo watamo owala sembe.
Daada mai kasi yamugo be kuma kasi wadugo kodume.
Demde am kanjum dumedon waddata debbo ninga rufugo eyam do bawo o dayi balde sedda sali do? 
Yaudiku toi be hokkata daada mai je rufugo eyam mai darata denbo olorna sembe mako? Shawara toi hokkata daada mai be bingel mako?
model_answer: Rufugo iyam caggal danygol ñaamnde seɗɗa (postpartum hemorrhage) ko rafi kiinɗo baawɗo warde so o yaɓɓitaaka law. Awa, ngaddore debbo oo e ɓingel makko to asibiti jonni, ɗo ɓe kokkata mo leɗɗe dartinirooje iyam (bana oxytocin walla misoprostol) e, so tawii haani, ɓe ndartinana mo ƴiiƴam. Ngam o lorna sembe makko, o jogii huccande leɗɗe njamndi (iron) e nyaamdu moƴƴu. Yo ɓingel makko ɗaane e non boorinɗi tan, ɗum wallita yummum oo wurtinde kosam e reende cellal maɓɓe. So tawii o dañii ɗum e sahaa, o selloto ko law.

question: dattijo gorko warini amin sibiti goɗɗo wi'i o ɗo nana hoore mako ɗo nawa daande mako ɗo tiiɗi be kuma foofe peppetel wurtini mo ha ɓandu o wari emugo ɗume on waddata irin ɗo be kuma irin dawa toi hokkatamo min emi goɗɗo mai ko nawugo hore mai jotta warini mo na ko seɗɗa seɗɗa warinimo dottijo mai wi warinimo jemma den bo halli jotta min eminimo bo o ɗo lara hite na o wi a'a ngam hite o tullinamo nawol hore min emi mo fu hala fofe ha ɓandu mako koɗo nawa sosai ko seɗɗa seɗɗa dottijo mai wi fu finimo pat ɓandu kuma o wawata ewugo da pellel bi'ugo da pellel gotel amma ɗo yayamo ɓawo kanjum min emimo ko o fotti be nyauɗo ovi wala oyahi banda sorugo hunde ha yeso sare maɓɓe ɗemɗe amin hari kita kanjum ɗon ko waddata nawol hore be dande tiddataɗo har o wala wailita dande be fofe kohatoi ha ɓandu mako ɗume waddata ɗum nyawu je raɓata ɗon naa ko hundeji fere ɗemɗe am jeɗiɗa bo irin godi toi goɗɗo ɗo waɗata en andata lallai ko heɓi mo heɓa anda dawa be lekki toi o naftirta ba ko jaaɓo rugo furta
reference:
Dottijo gorko warini Amin sibiti, goddo vii, odo nana hore mako donaawa. Daade mako do tiidii, be kuma foofe per peton vurtino ha bandu . Owari emugo dume don waddata irin do be kuma irin dawa toi hokkatamo. Min emmi goddo mai ko nawugo hore mai jotta warinimo na ko sedda sedda warinimo. Dottijo mai vi warinimo jamma denbo halli jotta. Min emmi mo bo odo laara hiite na? Ovi aa gam hiite o tullinamo naawol hore. Min emmi mo fu hala foofe ha bandu mako ko do naawa sosai ko sedda sedda. Dottijo mai vi foofinimo pat bandu bo kuma o wawata viyuwa da pelel gotel amma do nyanya mo.
Bawo kanjum min emmi mo ko o fotti be nyado . Ovi wala ha oyahi, banda sorrugo hunde ha yeso sare mabbe.
Dembe amin ha likita kanjum don kowaddata nyawol hore be daade tiidata do har o wala waylita daade, be foofe ko hatoi ha bandu mako? Dumewaddatadum? Ye’u je raabata donnaa or hundeji fere? Dembe am je didabo irin goji toi goddo do wadata en andata lallai kohebimo, heba anda dawa be lekki toi o naftirita bako jabargo vurta?
model_answer:
Alamaaji ɗi pottitaama (hoore nawre, daande tiiɗnde, foofe, e peppetel e ɓandu) ɗon holla nyawu meningitis, woni muumere ɓernde ndiiɗnde e ɓalndu, nyawu mawɗo raɓatooɗo yaawi.

Meningitis woni ko nyawu keɓata ɓernde ndiiɗnde e ɓalndu nden, o waawaa yaafaade to mo heɓaaki leɗɗe jaabɗe yaawre.

Sey nawtu mo yaawre to asibiti mawnde ɓurnde ɓada to ɓe keɓaa leɗɗe piye (antibiyotik) bana seftiraakson walla kloramfenikol liɗɗi, ngam hisnugo mo nguurndam.

To walaa asibiti mawnde e hoɗɗe, fuɗɗora mo laawol lekki ñaameteeɗo bana ofloxacin e doxycycline e jaango doktoor, amma ɗum waɗataa ko lomtorde piye.

Yimɓe ɓadiiɓe mo e nder saare maɓɓe sey ndaaree, ngam meningitis ɗon raɓa e kinne e jontaane; a waawi huutorgo lekki seftiraakson ngam haɗugo wonduɓe.

Debbo lari gorko mako do dojja be sembe to ummi be fajira bedo do leso maini. Dojjugo nonon ni fuddata, oneba ni bako dara. Baldeji owada ni o lari gorko mako o yarabone foofugo . To o yapi sedda ni ko ofa’e eskal , odo dara lorna fofde mako , denbo odo yawa sommugo be lau. Don yende gorko mako neebi odo dojja be odo habda lorna fofde , daami debbo mai. Ofuddi numugo ko don ye’u je wattada damuwajido . Jango mai sai o volwini gorko mako beyaha sibiti be laara likita, heba be hefta ko daamata mo. Demde mai, dumedon waddata dojjugo kalnudum banni be yawugo somugo, be foofugo daker do? Damuwa do wawan ko shafi balle na ko ye’u ko shafi berde?. Hundeji toi don watata goddo maya ko yarna goddo bone foofugo, harje goddo mai hadine dasa hikkilo yaudibe?

model_answer: Tortiiɗam maa holla wonde gorko oo e wondi e nyawu ɓernde ɓurtunde (heart failure) mo fooftere jo'ani, ɗum addanta mo fooftaade tiidaande, neebi ɓanndu, e fooftaade yoorde jamma. Ngam ɗuttugo kalnuɗi ɗi'i suudu, pamɗaa lamlam nder ɲamri fuu, mbaɗee mo ɗaanaade hoore mum dow piilow mawngu, ɓe njahee asibiti ngam heɓugo lekki diuretik (peccirɗam ndiyam) ɗe likita windata ngam yaafnugo fooftere. To ɓe njahaa, nyawu nguu ina waawa hawrude haa maayde—ɗum shafi ɓernde, naa yanko, kono yankoore ina waawa tawde. Nder suudu nyawndiigu, heɓata heftugo moƴƴo, ɓe ngartira sembe ɓernde ngam o wuura welde.

question: debbo fere mo duɓi cappan e ɗiɗi e ɗiɗi mo danyi ha asibiti balɗe tati ko sali waddi ɓingel mako hanɗe waɗugo diga kafi ɓikkoi keccon de o wari sai o yecci amin ɓingel ɗo sali musungo ha yotti ɓingel man wala sembe ko seɗɗa po ɗanan tan o vi ɓingel man wala joga en ɗi nden bo ko dey jungo mako kosɗe be ɓandu mako pat ɗo fewi delem har ɗo hulna mo to o memi ɓingel man be jungo mako har ndikka o hosa mo ha nder saɓɓode o hakkilini ɓingel man saali en ɗi ɓandu mako ɗo fewi to ɓe memi nden bo ɓandu man ɗo ɓedda watugo har o wala wawa ɓamta jungo mako forta kosɗe bo o wala dimba sam o ɗo wali babal gotel tan to a lari ɓingel man ni o ɗo yonti bo nyaugel ɗume dasi bannin man ɗume on a numata dasata ɓandu ɓikkoy keccon fewa delem to goɗɗo memi ko ngam o sali musungo on tan ko ngam ɗume on ɗume min wawata waɗugo hala salari kosam en ɗi man nden bo hala riga kafi handi min jaɓa man ɗume on shawara ma hado man
reference: Debbo fere moh dubi chappan eh Didi eh Didi moh danyi ha asibiti balde Tati ko sali waddi bingel mako hande wadugo riga kafi bikkoi kecchon. Deh o wari sei o yechchi Amin bingel doh sali musungo, ha yotti bingel man wala sembe koh sedda boh o danan tan. Ovi bingel man wala joga endi, denbo kodei jungo mako, kosde beh bandu mako pat doh fewi delem har doh hulna moh to’omemi bingel man beh jungo mako, har dikka o hosa moh hader sabbodeh. O hakkilini bingel man sali endi, bandu mako doh fewi to beh memi denbo bandu man do bedda watugo har o wala Wawa bamta jungo mako, forta kosde boh o wala dimbah sam, odo wali babal gotel tan. Toh a lari bingel manni odo yonti boh nyaugel. Dimeh Dasi bannin man? Dimeh on a numata dasata bandu bikkoi kecchon fewa delem toh goddo memi? Koh ngam o sali musungo on tan koh ngam dimeh on? Dimeh min wawata wadugo hala salareh kosam endi man? Denbo hala Riga kafi hadi min jabah man dimeh on shawara mah ha Dow man?
model_answer: Nyau man ko Tetanus Kesam (Neonatal Tetanus), sababi nyawu nguu ko bakteeriya *Clostridium tetani* naatiri e ɓoggi ɓingel to danygol. Ɓingel ina woya so memaama, ngam toxin mo bannge oo feƴƴini ina waɗa ɓalli ɓeyda tiiɗde, ɓeyda kadi ɓalndu (spasms) so taƴaaki. Wanaa tan ngam o salii musungo; ko nyawu bonɗo feere waɗata ɓandu man huɗɗaade. Ko min mbaawata waɗde haa jooni: nawanee ɓingel law law to asibiti mawngu to woodi toppitagol kesam, laɓɓinee ɓoggi makko e iodine, so tawii ina woodi, ndokkee Tetanus Immunoglobulin (TIG) e metronidazole, nden diazepam ngam leeltinde spasms, e toppitee ko o nyaamata e nder buusu so o salii dimba. Ɗum waɗee yaawde sabu nyau man ina bonan ɓingel law.

model_answer: Gorko debbo, ɓingel maa ɗon holla edem (woka) ha juuɗe e koyɗe—ɗum ɓuri heewde yi’eede ko e sukaaɓe tokosɓe ɓe ɓe keɓataa nyamri timmundi (kwashiorkor), malla ɗum waawi ummoraade e rafi ƴulɓe, ɓernde, malla naafa’on ƴiiƴam. Ɓanndu ɗoon noon, dimba ɓamtaare waɗi ina ɓeyda baasal e caawol ngam waɗde ñawanɗe bana tetanus. Mi wasi’iima njaawngal wara to asibiti, to ɓe keɓa teddeendam, njiytuɗam ɓanndu, e ƴeewndo ƴulɓe e ƴiiƴam ngam anndude caɗeele. To opitaal, min ndokkan mo nyamri safroore waɗnde (F-75/F-100) so tawii ko heege waɗi, malla leɗɗe haɗooje ñawanɗe e waɗde lekki ngam ustude edem so ina haani, min kebitiima kaa dimba ngam haɗude rafi. Wartu e ɓingel jooni, edem mo nyawrataa sahaa mum ina waawi bonnude ƴulɓe, ɓernde, e yiite makko.

question: debbo laari gorko maako ɗo mari nawol hoore nawol hoore may foɗai sam sam nawol hoore ɗo ɗo naawi ni har senda daande maako o teddi ni wawata waylutugo nanu be nyamo ni bana o handi se o laari kuulal ɓamari je walano ɓandu gorko may amma fuɗɗi vurti nonnon ɗum hulni debbo may ɗo irin kujeji fe'i dow ɓandu gorko mako ɗume on laati huunde may vurti kuma ɗume on o waɗata ko mi emi debbo may ba gorko ma komeɗi marugo zazzaɓi nawɗum na bekuma lekkitoy be naftiri ofii a a ko gorko may lesowo ɗanata ɗo pilow dawai ba o ɗani dow dandi mako ba ofii a a dani dow dandi mako ba nonnon nawol hore mai wari sai wardi be tiddol dandi kuma pulel perpetel vurtini mo ha ɓandu mako ko irin kuje bannin fedi dume ɗon irin debbo ɗo waɗata wallititta gorko mako be lorninamo ɓandu bana no wonno

model_answer: Debbo, ɗum alamaaji meningitis (nuunɗu hoore) bonɗi, ɗon holla infeksiyon tedduɗo nder ƴiiƴam. Nawra hore mawnge, tiddol daande, e pulel perpetel ɓalewol ɗon mbaadi petechiae (ƴiiƴam les deri ngam mboros) ɗon waɗa gorko maa nder haɓɓere. Ɗum nyau yaawɗo maayde; taw gorko ma heɓaay lekki yaawre, o waawi maayde nder sahaa seɗɗa. Ngaɗaa ko nyawma: njaaɓondir gorko maa law law to asibiti mawɗo ngam dokke mo enjeksiyon antibiotic nder ƴiiƴam. Woto ɗowtaano safaara gaadanteeri walla lekkitoy wuro; yah to doktoor jooni, ko tan woni no hisnetee ngurndan makko.

question: daada peju ɗon mari ɓikkon tati peju ɗon petel may peju ɗon mari duuɓi gotel daada peju may hirliti ɓawo ɓalɗe seɗɗa nde o danyi peju ɗon mari nyawu dojjugo kuma tun wakkati may o ɗo ta ojja wala darugo sam o wi kuma o hirliti fofugo fu ɗo hokka mo bone o wi ɗojjugo ɗo yawanci ɗo warinamo be kikkiɗe wakkati komoi fu nasti ɗo ɗana o wi fofugo mako ɗo sadinamo o fofata boɗɗum kam ɗojjugo ɗo wala accamo o fofa o wurtina boɗɗum o wi o yahi haa nyawdigo gargajiya kuma hokkimo lekki gargajiya amma o hirliti wala ko huwinimo se o wi o dilli tan o yahi asibiti heba ɓe hefta ko fe'ata be pejum damuwa ɗo wawan hoyina ɓingel ɗo na damuwa ɓerde na ko asima ɗon fe'ata be ɓingel ɗo kujeji toy ɗon hanɗi ɓingel ɗo hanɗi acca heɓa ko damata mo waɗinta mo o ɗojja hoyina mo usta sosai
reference: Daada  peju, do mari bikkon tati, peju don petel mai . Peju domari dubu gotel. Daada peju mai hirliti bawo palde sedda dai odayi . Peju do mari ye’u dojjugo, kuma tun wakati mai odo ta dojja wala darugo sam . Ovi kuma o hirliti foofugo fu do hokkamo bone.ovi dojjugo do yawanchi do warinamo be kikkide  wakati komai fu nasti do naana. Ovi foofugo mako do sadina mo ofoofa boddum. Kam dojjugo do wala acchamo o foofa o vurtina boddum . Ovi oyahi ha yaudiko gargajiya kuma hokkimo lekki gargajiya amma o hirliti wala ko huwunimo. So ovi odilli tan oyahi sibiti heba be o hefta ko fedata be peju. Damuwa do waawan hoyina bingel do na? Damuwa berde na ko asma don feddata be bingel do? Kujeji toi don haadi bingel do haadi accha, heba ko damaatamo wadintamo o dojja hoyinnamo, usta sosai?
model_answer:
Nyawu ɗo fe'ata ko ɓingel ngel ina waawi wonde asima, sabu ɗo wadda dojjugol, kikkiɗe e mettere fofaango, ko haani ɓernde mum tampina.  
Ngam hoynaango jaawde, rokku ɓingel nge salbutamol bee inhaler walla kompiwal spacer, ɗum wurtina laawol henndu nder ɓernde.  
O mari duuɓi go’o o wala darugo, ɗum holla wonde nyawu nguu juutii walla ɓanndu makko heɓaay nyaamdu jaajɗo; ɗum waɗi ƴeewndo tiiɗngo haa asibiti.  
To asibiti, ɓe mbaawaa ƴeewtaade ɓernde mum e ɓalli goɗɗi, tawa kadi ina woodi caɗeele goɗɗe baasal bana TB walla ɓernde ɓamtaare.  
Safaara aada o hokkunaama ko mehe, accu ɗum, jokku safaara safrirde, tawa ko ɓe keɓa timmungol safaara maa o usta sosai, o fofa boɗɗum.

question: gorko am dubi mako cabbane nayi den bo mi hirliti sati tati ko sali dum o do fiyi ta yara diyam sosai sosai no yarata diyam mai nonnon o sillata to o yari duddum ma nonnon kuma nonnon ma be jemma o finai wadan de sappo o ummi o yaha o silla o do woka fu o do nana jumri kullum bo o don beddi bandu sedda wakkati fere o do fiya o do lara daure o wala lara boddum to o ummi o do wanca mi hirliti o do silla akai akai be duddum bo dume on watata sillugo mere mere do be donka do ko wadi o yarata diyam duddum den bo o do silla duddum ko alamaji do wawan jeyan shuga ko hundeji fere don awnugo toi be goji toi wadata a heba hefta irin yahu toi don do ko wadi o do somi kullum do dume on waddata sellugo akai akai do do sembe inyam mako bamti on waddata yamu do ko diyam bandu mako timmina ko kuje fere don tan irin yiri be kujeji yarugo toi o accata kuma dume on handi o dinga yamugo mataki toi hosata vallititta alamaji do dey handi noi goji be haunugo je yahu shuga handi wada kullum na koyande go yande go yewtoi don wadata alamaji do je fe'ata ha bandu mako
reference:
Gorko am dubi mako cappende ni. Denbo mi hirliti saati tati ko saali do odo fi ta yara diyam sosai sosai. No o yarata deyam mai nonon o sillata. Toh oyari dumdum ma nonnon. Kuma nonnon ma be jamma o finai wadai de sappo, o ummi o yaha o silla. Odo wooka fu, odo nana chomri kullum. Bo odon beddi bandu sedda. Wakati fere odo fi’a o do lara dowre, owala laara boddum to o ummi odo wancha. Mi hirliti odo silla akai akai bo dundum bo. Dumedon watata sillugo mere mere do be donka do? Kwadi oyarata diyam dumdum denbo odo silla duddum? Ko alaamaji do waawan je ye’u shuga, ko hundeji fere don? Haunigo toi be goji toi waddata heba hefta irin ye’u toi don do? model_answer:
Alamaaji ɗii ko wayi no yarugo ndiyam heewɗam, sillugo saabunde, ŋakkere semmbe e boyaari ɓalli, ɗum no feƴƴatina nyawu suukar (shuga).  
O yahra law law to asibiti walla nokku celluɗo ngam ƴeeŋtude suukar e nder ƴiiƴam e fitinnde.  
To shuga tawima, doktoore waɗan mo lekki (kamani metformin) e wasiyyaaji: o haɗanaa nyaamduuji welɗi, o ɗama ndiyam laaɓɗam, o nyaama ko ɓuuɓata seeɗa-seeɗa bana gawri, ɓiɓɓe leɗɗe, e liɗɗi.  
So o safraaki, shuga ina waawa battinde e rafiiji ɓernde, niteeku, walla koma nguleeki ɓanndu, ɗum noon jom suudu mum ina haani reeninde e koyɗe makko, yejjitaare e temmbu wakkati omo umma.  
Fuu ko woni, ƴeewndo yaawngo e jokkindiraagal e safrooɓe nokkuure mbaɗan semmbe ɓanndu makko arde, o dañan cellal.

question: redujo wari sibiti kikkiɗe ɗo sey o wi gorko maako ɗo holina mo akai akai ɓe ɗo dufa mo kullum o wi ɗo wati mo o dinga hurtugo nyalanɗe ɗuɗɗum to o nani gorko mako ɗo warta sare ko to o nangan lawol sare sey o ɗo hurtira ngam o ɗo dami ta o tappan mo ko o huɗan mo o hirliti fuu ɓerde mako ɗo dogga ɗo fiya o dilli hawnugo sembe iyam mako sey o tawi ɗo wa'i sey o wi'i o tori ballinde ha saare mako be o yecci ɓe wanni mo bayani mo wanni mo bayani ko fe'ata kanjum ɗon saare mako hokki mo lekki gargajiya amma wala ko acci sam ɓawo o naftiri o yiɗi o anda ɗume on o waɗata heɓa ta o ringa hurturgo sosai ɗon to ɗo hota saare ko to o nani gorko mako ɗo warta ɗume on o waɗata o lornina hakkilo mako ɓerde mako wala jam e hakkilo
reference:
Reedujo wari sibiti kikide do, sai ovi gorko mako do hoolinaamo akai akai be do doofa mo kullum. Ovi do watimo odinga hurtuluggo. Yalaade dumdum to onani gorko mako do warta saare ko to onangan lawol sare, se odo hurtila gam odo daami ta o tappamo ko o huda mo.
O hirliti fuu berde mako do dogga, do fi’ya. O dilli haunugo sembe eyam mako, se tawi do fa’i.
 Sai ovi o tori vallinde ha saaro mako be oyechhi be wanni be bayani ko feddata.  Kanjum don saare mako hokkimo lekki gargajiya amma wala ko acchi sam bawo o naftiri.
Oyidi o anda, dume don o wadata heba ta oringa hurlituko sosai do, to odo hota sare ko to o nani gorko mako do warta? 
Dume don owadata o lornina  hakkilo mako, berde mako waala , jam e hakkilo?
model_answer: Nyawu mon ngol iwataa ko e ɓalli, ammaa ko e kulol duumiingol nde gorko mon hulɓiniri on; kaŋko waɗi ɓernde mon ina doga, boŋŋgo ina semmbina, on nana kulol malla semmbe mon ina yahra so o warta. Ko adii fof, mi wasiyoo on ngarey sibiti ngam ƴeewteede, ngam heɓugo ballal hakkillo (counseling) e wasiyaaji kisal nder wuro mon. Ndee sahaa panike, etin foondugo luggiɗngo: fooɗoy boŋŋgo e hunnduko maa fuunaa leelɗum, ɗaccu boŋŋgo booɗɗum kadi leelɗum; ɗum newnana ɓernde e hakkillo wakkati muusɗam. So tawii kulol ngol ina ɓeydoo, omo waawi ƴeɓɓaade ballal to suudu rewɓe (shelter) malla polis ngam kisal makko, ngam torla otoo woodaa. Tamminde am, ballal hakkillo e renndo ina waawi artirde jam e ɓernde e hakkillo maa, ammaa teeŋtin heɓugo kisal ko law.

question: daada je wondi ha dadirabe je waddata bikkoi mabbe tefugo batal o famtini o yi'i keccal mako do mari damuwa ha hunduko mako bo laɓɓo bingel mai do wadi blue hande sai o yi'i to o do musina bingel mai o do torra heɓata hendu boɗɗum be kuma ɗon hokka mo bone fofugo boɗɗum o wi kanjum ɗon sakli mo sam gam o anda ko ko fe'ata be keccel mako ɗume on watta ta ɗeɓol ɓingel mai waɗa blue bannin ɗume on kuma watta ɓingel torra bo heɓa damuwa fofugol ɗo to ɗo muse na lekki ɗon ɓe hokkata na ko ɓe larai mingel mai na
reference:
Daada je wondi ha daadirabe je waddata bikkoi mappe tufugo baatal ofamtini  o ye’u kecchel mako do mari damuwa ha hundeko mako, bo lebol mingel mai o wadi buluu .
Hande sai o yi’i to odo musina bingel mai, odo torra , hebata hendu boddum , be kuma do hokkamo bone foofugo boddum. Ovi kanjum don saklimo sam gam ohanda ko feddata be kecchel mako.
Dumedon watata lebol mingel wada buluu banni? Dume don kuma waddata mingel torra bo heba damuwa foofugo to’ do musina? Lekki don be hokkatanaaa, ko be larai mingel mai na?
model_answer:
Ko ɓe mbaɗi e ɗeɓol ɓingel maa waɗi ɗum laato blue, ko lekki ina wiyee **methylene blue** (leɓɓol blue) ɓe kokki ɗon.  
Lekki oo ina waawi naatde e nder ƴiiƴam ɓingel o, addana ɗum rafi **methemoglobinemia**, ɗum haɗan ƴiiƴam fijirde oksijen timmuɗo.  
Ɗum woni ko waɗata ɓingel maa waɗa blue e torraade heɓtaade henndu.  
Kecce laaɓɗe e hunnduko ɗee ko **fiɓnde ina wiyee thrush** (moniliasis), naa ko bonnata e mum.  
**Yaawtu, yahdu e opitaal mawɗo jooni**; ɓe ndaartan ƴiiƴam, ɓe ndokka mo oksijen e lekkol hawtiingo – ɗum tan hisnan ɓingel maa.

question: dada joɗata ha fattude amin ɗo mari redu je ɓingel mako ɗiɗabo ha fuɗɗere redu mai komai o yaha dai- dai o ɗo nana belɗum ɓingel fere ɗo wara amma lewru seɗɗa ko saali ɗo o fuɗɗi nanugo les redu mako ɗo nawa nyande nawɗum mai waɗi mo sossai har dakai o darata boɗɗum neɓai sam ɓawo ton o fuɗɗi rufugo iyam sossai rufugo iyam mai nda no rufata ɗon ba rufi sossai kuma watti mo tuni o do somi nde o lari iyam mai sai o wurtiri ta ni ɗon ko fe'i be ɓingel mako gorko mako yawi valli mo ɓeyahi sibiti ɗemle am kanjum ɗume ɗon watata nawugo les redu haa redujo rufugo iyam sosai ɗo alama hattara ɗon nana jey dada ko ɓingel haa redu may ɗume on alama goɗɗo larata redu may ɗon damuwa ɗon lekki jey darnata nawɗum may na ɓeddarna iyam may jey nawnata ɓingel may
reference: Daada, joodata ha  fattude amin. Do mari redu je mingel mako didabu. A fuddurde reedu mai komai oyaha daidai, odo nana beldum bingel feere do wara . Amma lewru sedda ko saalido ofuddi nanugo les reedu mako do naawa. Yende naudum mai wadi mo sosai, har daker o darata boddum. Nebai sam, bawo toin ofuddi rufugo eyam sosai . Rufugo eyam mai da no rufata don ba, rufi sosai kuma waati mo chomri odo Sommi. Dai o laari eyam mai, sai o hurtili taani don ko fe’di be bingel mako. Gorko mako yawi vallimo be yahi sibiti. Demde am kanju, dume don watata nawugo les reedu ha reedujo? Rufugo eyam sosai do alaama hattara don na je daada ko bingel ha redu mai? Dumedon alaama goddo laarata redu mai don damuwa? Don lekki je darnata naudum mai na be darna eyam mai je nawnata bingel mai?
model_answer: Nawre les reedu tiiɗnde e rufuki iyam sossai e debbo reedu ko alamaaji hattara mawɗi ɗon holla toksemia reedu (pre-eclampsia mawnde) malla abruption placenta (reedu seertii e ɓingel) – kamɓe ɗon waɗa reedu nana metti haa debbo waawa daraaki, iyam ɗon rufa, ɗum ɓeydoo heebannde reedu. Ɗum alama hattara mawnde wonande daada e ɓingel sabu ɗon waawi warde maɓɓe law. Lekki darnata nawre ndu e darnata iyam ɗon waawi heɓaaka so naa nder opitaal mawɗo ɗo ɓe kokkata debbo oo magnesium sulfate, leɗɗe ɗe ngaddata iyam (transfusion), ɓe ittana ɓingel ngam hisnude daada e ɓingel. So a yiyii debbo ina wonda e maandeeji ɗii, a waɗa semmbe yawre ngam o yaɓɓa opitaal o warde ɓingel ko yaawani. Waktu ko carel; leeltol waawi warude daada e ɓingel.

question: likita daada joɗata haa sare amin lari ɓingel maako wala musugo boɗɗum nde o yiɗi o musina mo sey ɓingel may musina seɗɗa sey yofta bana o ɗo somi daada may bo hirliti ɓingel may wala sembe musugo nden bo o ɗo fita wulina sosai ha hore be yeso na kanjum tamba nden bo fofugo ɓingel may canji o ɗo fofa bana yaha dow dow ɓeɗo jippa les les bana goɗɗo mo hokkata wani fofugo ɓalleji ɗo dilla ni dada may o ɓedda damugo o ɗo tamma ko gam ɓingel may wala musina ko heyata ko ɗon damuwa fere je ɗo hauti be fofugo be wolwa ɓingel may to sey o wi ha o yaha sibiti o lara likita koyninamo ɓingel mako ɗemne am ɗume on latata ɓingel heɓa damuwa musungo boɗɗum no ɓingel may fofata ɗo alama nyamu fere ɗon na alamaji hattara toy dada be ɓaɓa ɓingel may hakkilinta ɗume on wattata ɓingel petel wolwugo to ɗo musina
reference:
Likita, daada joodata ha sare amin, laari mingel mako wala musungo boddum. Dai o idi o musinamo sai mingel mai musina sedda sai yofta bana odo somi. Dada mai bo hirliti bingel mai wala sembe musungo denbo odo fi ta wulina sosai ha hore be yeso. Da kanjum tanba denbo foofugo bingel mai changi. Odo foofa bana yaha do do be do jippa les les , bana goddo mo hokkata bone foofugo. Balleji do dilla ni, daada mai obedda damugo. Odo tamma ko gam bingel mai wala musuna ko heyata ko don damuwa fere je do hauti be foofugo be vulungo bingel mai. Toh sai ovi ha oyaha sibiti olaara likita hauninamo bingel mako. 
 Demde am, dumedon lattata bingel heba damuwa musungo boddum? No bingel mai foofata do, alaama nyawu fere Donna?  Alaamaji hattara toi daada be baaba mingel mai hokkilinta? Dumedon waatata mingel petel vulungo todo musina?
model_answer:
Nyawu ɓingel ina waawi wonde nyawu fooftere mawɗo (pneumonie) malla ñawu ɓuuɓol fooftere (bronchiolite) baɗɗungol caɗeele fooftere e tampere, ɗum waɗi ɓingel walaa sembe musude.
Alamaji hattara ɗon: fofugo jaawngo no feewi (>60 e hojoma), fooftere ina teddina (ina holla koyngal yeeso/sonde fooftere), walaa sembe musude, tampere, e ɓingel ina yofta musinol e nder torra.
Sey law law ɓe neldi ɓingel to opitaal mawɗo ngam heɓugo oksijen e ñawndi leɗɗe (antibiyotik) ɗe safroowo hokkata.
Daada e ɓaɓa ina poti hakkillaade so ɓingel fofii ko ɓuri heewi, ɓalndu maggo naati nder fooftere, tampere ɓeydii, ɓingel woppi musude fof, walla waɗii fitinaaji.
Waatataa leɗɗe aadaaji; hakkunde laawol, ndiyam ɓooyngel seeɗa seeɗa musine e kuddu haa ɓe njaha opitaal ngam hisnugo ngeedam ɓingel.

question: debbo ɗo danyi ha amin fajira ɗo veyti ɗo danyi de o wari jambi jeytati be fajira mun wondi be mako hasare yoni amin vi debbo ɗo ɓandu mako do diwna bo ɗo wuli sosai den bo o ɗo mari damuwaji ko shafi ɓandu mako je damata mo sosai min yahi min lari debbo mai min suddi mo be kare min auni wolwugo ɓandu mako min tawi 38.2 min wanni mo goɗɗi ɓe nyamu cuufi gam debbo ɗo welnai o nanɗi maleriya min emi mo ko wonɗi ko o nyami o wi wala ko o nyami min yetti mo wonɗi mo wonɗi be mako ɓe hokka mo sha'i o yara min emi mo o musini hande na se o wi de o wari musungo ɓingel may sey o tawi keccel may riwi sey min wi debbo may o umma o joɗa o ɓara ɓawo mako heɓa vallita ɓandu mako hoyna seɗɗa ɗo pat ɗa pat ba amma vallitai bo gite mako laaɓai min sawri mo to nyamini sai o yara paracetamol to o yari paracetamol mai timmi sai min lara dai ɗon hanɗi min hokka mo fahin o ɗo mari malaria kuma min waɗi mo goji mai useni min wawan min hokka mo fahin to o timmini yamugo ɗen bo min sauri mo o yara paracetamol tunda o satai to dillai ni min handi yaudi dim min mokamo min hokka to

Debbo do dayi ha amin fajira do. Veeti do o dayi. Min wanni mo goji be nawu chufi. Kam debbo do velnai, o nandi malariya . Min emmi mo ko woodi ko o yaami, ovi wala ko Oyami. Min yechi mo vondi be mako, be hokkamo shaa’i o yara. Min emmimo o musini hande na? Sai ovi dai owari musungo bingel mai, sai o tawi kecchel mai riiwi.

To oyari paracetamol mai timmi , sai min lara dai don haadi minhokka mo fein. Odo mari malayria kuma min wani mo goji mai . Useni min waawanmihokka mo fein. model_answer: Debbo maaɗa, mo danyi, o woodi tooñere bana maleriya, ammaa tawde o heɓii lekki “cuufi” koo paracetamol tan, sey en ƴeewa ɓerɗe no o yahrata. To aɗon waawi, waɗanee mo jarrabawol maleriya (RDT) ngam tabitinnde; so o woodi, hokku mo lekki ACT bana Coartem (artemether/lumefantrine) balɗe tati timmuɗe, wonaa paracetamol tan. So o timminii ACT, o ɗaɓɓan ndiyam heewi e ñaameteeɗe baawɗe, ngam ɓanndu makko e ɓikkon mum njamda. To tooñere makko walaa ƴellitaade caggal balɗe ɗiɗi e ACT, walla o fuɗɗi ummaade boykoy tati (chills), ɓernde yani, ndeen miijow on ko puerperal sepsis, ɗum waɗi hokku mo antibiyotik bana amoxicillin-clavulanate walla ceftriaxone e ɓanndu. Tuma fuu, laaɓal nokkuure e golle deƴƴuɗe ina hisna mo e jabet. So o ɗaɓɓi, ngartiranee mo to opitaal ngam ɗaɓɓitaade.

question: ɓe waddi debbo fere sibiti hanɗe fajira ɗo iyam ɗo rufa ha mako sosai fa kuma ɗo sakli mo ɗa seɗɗa ɓe emi mo ko irin ɗo meɗi feɗugo be mako o wi meɗi feɗugo ɗe ɗiɗi ko sali ɗe fe'ata o ɗo nana nauɗum den bo iyam mai rufata a rufata be emi ko reɗu ɗon rufata o wi o anda ko oɗon mari reɗu ko oɗo be reɗu be emi dai o lari al'ada mako o wi neɓai ko o lari o wi o lari bana lewru gotel be reta bako rufugo em ɗo fuɗɗi dai hande fajira useni ɗume on watata debbo rufugo em sosai ɗo banni mataki geggewal toi hosata yahu ndigi toi hokkata debbo ɗo hisnu yonki mako be darnata emmai lekkiji toi be bateji toi be hokkatamo je darnata emmai

Be waddi debbi fere sibiti hande fajira do, eyam do rufa ha mako sosai fah, kuma do sakli mo daa sedda. Be demi mo, ko irin do meddi fudugo be mako, ovi medi fudugo de didi ko saali. De fedata odo nana naudum, denbo eyam mai rufa ta’a rufa ta’a. Be ummi ko reedu don rufata. Ovi o anda ko odon no mari redu ko odo bee redu . Be emmi dai olaari al haada mako , ovi nebbai ko o laari .ovi o lari bana lewru gotel be reeta boko rufugo eyam do fuddi fein hande fajira. Useni dime don watata debbo rufugo eyam sosai do banni? Mataki gwagaawal toi hosata? Yaudigi toi hokkata debbo do hisnu yonkimaako be darnata eyam mai?
Lekkiji toi be baatedi toi be hokkatamo je darnata eyam mai?
Kuma hownugo toi be waawata be wadda, be hefta dume waddi rufugo eyam kulnidum do?
model_answer: Debbo oo ina wondi e rufgo iyam reedu saɗɗam, ko maande miscarriage mo haani hisnineeki yonki. Arande fuu, mbaɗanen mo laawol ɓeydugol ndiyam e nder ƴiye (drip Ringer’s Lactate walla Normal Saline) ngam darnugo tiitoonde ƴiiƴam. Ndeen ndokken mo lekki darnugo reedu, hono oxytocin (10 IU e cowu) walla misoprostol (800 mcg e nder koyngal) ngam haɗugo iyam jaawnga. So iyam jokki walla reedu wooɗii, haani ittugol ko heddii e reedu (evacuation) e juuɗe annduɗo. To o ɓuuɗii ƴiiƴam masin, mbaɗanen mo ƴiiƴam (transfusion) ngam hisnude mo. So kuuje ɗee ngalaa to opitaal men, en neldan mo jaawnga to opitaal mawɗo ɗo o heɓa ballal timmungal.

question: alaa bukkum wi'i o ɗo yi'a daure kanjum be comre bo hoore nawata mo ɗo haɗi mo joɗe ɓelɗe sati ɗiɗi ko sali o wala ɗana jamma boɗɗum sam koste mako ɗiɗi be juɗe mako be yeso fu pat ni ɗo ɓuuti ɓuuti o ɗo ta ni haɓɓa mai be sauri mo o yara hunɗe jifere ni amma dai fu pat wala ko hoini sam amma ni be bi mo o tammi waɗugo dama be lari mo da be bi da ko shafi fofugo ɗon ba ko handi ni be waɗa be waɗi be bi da ko ɗume manga ɗon ba odo faɗa eskal wala bone sembe iyam mako fuu be auni be tawi 168 of a 100 gam mai be vi o siwta be godi sembe iyam mako fahim be tawi 150 over 90 be lari bo odo be redu toh sey be hokki mo lekki je sembe iyam mako ɗo wa'i je marɓe redu ngam lekki mai wala damuwa ha jamu redu ɓe yecci mo kala hundeji fu je'o watta ɓandu mako hundeji tornatamo sosai watta ta sembe iyam mako bedda demde am ba ɓawo hundeji ɓe wanni irin jamu redu do je ɗo mari namugo hore kullum be uppugo yeso mataki toy hosata hado redu do ta nyawu yotta har debbo ɗo jimma

Agaji arannde: daran ɓinngel ngel darnde foofaango weeɓa, laaɓtok hunnduko e nofru so hunnduko heewi kosam malla ndiyam; woto fuɗɗo musinno so foofaango bonni.

model_answer:
Debbo reduujo mo lebbi 6, ɓernde fijra lawlaw e mettere dow ɓernde, hawti e uppagol dande (goiter), ina waawi wonde ko maande nyawu "hyperthyroidism" (gollol thyroid ɓeydii).  
Ndeeɗoo wonnde so nde safraaka, ina waawi mema mawnugol ɓingel e addude jibineede e ɓingel tedduɗo walla reedu yahde ko yaawi.  
O foti yaawde yahude to doktoor ngam ƴeewndaade, waɗa ƴiiƴam ƴeewndorɗam thyroid, ngam anndude caɗeele ɗee e fuɗɗoode.  
Alamaaji kulɓiniiɗi ɗi poti ndaarɗeede : ɓernde fijra haa heewi (ko ɓuri 120 e nder hoɗorde), ɓanndu nguleeki, boɗɗol, tampol mawngol, walla reedu fuɗɗaago mettinde.  
So o anndinaama, o waawi huutorgo leɗɗe antithyroid hono propylthiouracil (PTU) e leɗɗe ɗe paltata ɓernde (beta-blocker) e dow laawol doktoor; o haɗee ñaameteeɗi baɗɗi iyod ceertuɗi, o daɗɗu kulol, o rewi toppitagol haa saanga ronki.

model_answer:
Alamuuji ɗi ɓiɗɗo maa holli (fofa wuliingo e ɓuttiingo, wookaade diga ɓaawo teemedde e jemma, salaago musnugo) ɗon holla nyawu meningitis (iltingel ɓernde-siko), ɗum woni ñawu kiitorɗum gonɗum e mbaadi ɓanndu.  
Ɗum heɓata ko nde ɓiɗɗo o heɓi ñawu baasal ɓanndu, haa teeŋti nde o haɓaama musngo non boo o fuɗɗii ñaameteele kese ɗe mbaawaa mo.  
Ko haani yo a yahru e law e suudu nyawndi ɓanndu (hopital) ɗo ɓe kokkiri ɓiɗɗo lekkiije ɓutteede bana ceftriaxone e toppitagol yaawɗo, ngam ngam hisnude heedɗo.  
To ɓiɗɗo wooki, woto ngoppu e miijaade colique walla lekkije ɗe mobel, ngam ɗum alamu emergency caatuɗo; fofa wuliingo e ɓuttiingo ko huunde ɓanndu meeɗaani yi’eede.  
Nyaamu, defte walla lekkije leɗɗe ɗe nguurndam wonaa haɗude ñawu ngu; aɗa waɗa hasre heɓa ɓiɗɗo maaɗa ɗana boɗɗum jemma tan ko e yaawgo haa dokto’en mbaɗa safaara timmuɗo.

Amma jonta, babal rawandu mai gati fuddi vurtungo namputere bo ɓuti. En yechi ɓe eyara mo asibiti. Useni, iri kala lirore toi ewannata ɓingel ɗoh? model_answer:
Rawandu ɓingel ɗo nyawndam no feewi sabo taƴre gargajiya e leɗɗe laaɓaani, ɗum addani naatgol bakteriyaaji.
O haani toppitagol e nder asibiti: laɓɓingol rawandu, ittugol teƴe maayɗe, e rokkude lekki antibiyotik hono metronidazole e cloxacillin.
Sukaa oo ina waawi heɓde wutandu no feewi, sabu rawandu mawndu ndu waɗaa e kaɓirɗe ɗe ngalaa laaɓal, tawi o heɓaaki lekkol tetanus.
Sababu bonngol rawandu ɗo ko naatgol bakteriyaaji e sahaa nde gargajiya taƴi ɓalli e waɗde leɗɗe njahraani laaɓde.
E asibiti, ina jooni yiɗaa ƴeewndo timmungo ngam anndinde woodi nyawuuji goɗɗi hono sepsis, ŋakkeende nyaamdu, walla bone e ƴiye.

question: debbo jarmajo ɗo jogi ɓingel mako nde o laari zazzabi nangi ngam ɓingel may nonnon tan fuɗɗi dimbugo ɓingel may ɗo waɗa jonɗo o wala nder hakkilo iri nyawu toi heɓa ɓingel dada musumi ɗo be irin hakkulinga toi hakkilinta ɓingel ɗo
reference: Debbo jarmaajo do jogi bingel mako , de olaari zaszabi nangi gel , bingel mai nonnon tan fuddi dibbugo .Bingel mai do wada jindol owal der hakkilo . Irin yeu toi hebbi bingel daada  musunoddo do? Be irin hakkulingo toi hakkilinta bingel do?
model_answer: Salaamu. Ɓingel maa heɓii maasum malaria cerebral sabu dimbugo e majjingo hakkillo ina kawrita e zazzabi, ɗum ko bonɗum e sukaaɓe. Ina waawi kadi wonde meningitis (nyawu mumɗe ɓanndu-baagol) walla konvulsifon feere. Aɗa foti yahde opitaal mawɗo jaawngol ngam ƴeewndaade ƴiiƴam e pentol ndiyam ɓaawo ngam anndude ko woni. Ɓe kokkata antimalaria e leɗɗe haɗooje dimbugo e nder ƴiiƴam, ɗum hisnata ɓingel. Woto ɗaɓɓu safrude e gaadanteeje tan, sabu ɗum waawi ɓurtina nyawu nguu.

question: dada musunowo hirliti ɓingel mako kuma o ɗo lara ni ɓanɗu ɓingel ɗo ɗo wula wakkati go dada lori vi'i o yi ɓawo awa seɗɗa sali oyi ɓanɗu ɓingel may gabaki ɗaya tiiɗi sai o faɗɗi bo o anda ko labol mako ɗo maɓɓi gam kujeji ɗiyam ɗo wurtinamo ha hunduko kuma ɗingel may wawa ta moɗa kalan yiri fu jotta o ɗo emma irikita ko irin ɗo mara dama kuma be irin yau toyi ganandi ko o wawan o heɓa ɓatal koje gargajiya be sabulu gargajiya ɗon be naftirta ɓingel be irin yauɗo ha leyol o vurti
reference:
Daada musunoodo, hirliti bingel mako kuma odo laara ni bandu bingeldo, dowula wakatigo . Daada lori vi oyi bawoo awaa sedda saali oyi bandu bingel mai gabaakidaya tiidii se o faddi. Bo o anda ko leebol mako do mappi, gam kujeeji diam do vurtinamo ha hunduko. Kuma hingel mai wawata moda kala yiiri fu.
Jotta odo ema likita ko irin yeu do maran daama, kuma be irin yeu toi ga nandi, ko owaawan oheba  baatal koje gargajiya be sabulu gargajiya don be nefartirinta bingel be irin yewu do, ha lenyol o furti.
model_answer:
Ko nyawu hiɓɓo (tetanus) waɗi ɓingel maaɗa, ummaade e gaɓɓal wulaago ngal laaɓaaki, ɗum ɗon waɗa ɓanɗu tiiɗndu e wawaa moɗaago e ɗiyam ɗon wurtina ha hunduko.
Ñawu ɗuuɗo ɓeydaago law, doole ɓingel yahaa asibiti law ngam heɓugo enjeksiyon anti-toxin e magani ɗon haɓɓoo ñawu nguu.
Lekki gargajiya bana ɓatal e sabulu ɗon ɓe mbaɗata nder leyol waawaa nyawndugo ɓingel, ina waawi ɓeydaango nyawu maako, haa halkumo.
Haɗiide, ñawu hiɓɓo ina waawi haɗeede so ɓingel heɓii ceɗe (vaccine) diga asibiti nde ɗum ɓillaani.
Miɗo ɗaɓɓito on ngaddon ɓingel haa asibiti law, ngam kala dilli ina waawi warugo mo.

question: mama yi'i ɓingel mako mo o ɗo wandi be mako tun o ɗa nyi ɓingel hakkunde ɓawo tati ɗum waɗi iyam rufata ɓawo danyugo o rufa ɓe gau be sembe dadai ba o yi'i ni fu ɓingel mako ɗo laɓi juɗe kosɗe yeso nafuru fu ɗo laɓi o ɗo ta diwna ɓandu ɗo bo o woli amma ha nder balɗe tati ɗo ko saali ɗo koste mako be juɗe mai fu ɗo fewi bo ɗo somi somi ni sosai bo wala ko a wawata waɗugo kanjum waɗi o waddi mo asibiti heɓa likita lara ɓandu mako o emi ko wawan likita mai lotai babel ɓingel mai joɗata boɗɗum ko kanjum waddata rufugo iyam sembe mai bo o tori likita mai vindinamo bata ko lekki je ɗarnata iyammai e ɓadadamai lornita sembe mako wawa hakkilina ɓingelmako
reference:
Maama yi’i bingel mako,mo odo wondi be mako tun o dayi bingel, hakkunde bawo tati dum wadi, eyam rufata bawo dayugo, o rufa belau be sembe da daidai ba. Oyi’i ni fuu bingel mako do laapi , judde, koste, yeeso, nofuru fuu do laapi. Odo ta dewna bandu bo owuli. Amma ha der balle tati ko saali do koste mako be juude mai fu doo feewi. Oemmi ko wawan likita mai lootai babel mingel mai joodata boddum, ko kanjum waddata rufugo eyam sembe mai.
Bo otori likita mai vindimo baatal ko lekki je darnata eyam mai, eba daada mai lornita sembe mako waawa hakkilina bingel mako.
model_answer: Mi jaaraama, mi nani tornde ma. Ko ɓingel maa waɗi ko nyau “Vitamin K deficiency bleeding” (NDBK), ɗum waɗataa sabu ɓanndu mum heɓaaki vitamin K haa yettaa caggal danygo, ɗum waɗi iyam rufata e ɓawo, ɓingel laɓi, e ɓaawo man o heɓi saali e sembe majjii. Vitamin K ko ɗarnata iyam; so en ngokki ɓingel vitamin K e leggal, iyam ɗon dara. So tawii iyam majjii no feewi, en mbaawan hokkude ɓingel ƴiiƴam (transfusion) ngam lornita sembe mum, haa o hoota e cellal. Ɗum ko nyau haɗeeteengo so a hokki ɓingel vitamin K nder balɗe 1 caggal danygo, kono jaŋngo yeeso seeda e ɗemngal ngal en ndaɓɓan jaɓɓaago vitamin K wonande ɓiɓɓe keso fuu. question: renowo ɓingel mo hakkilinta ɓingel petel hirliti ɓingel ɗo hakkilinta mai dakkere fofata nden bo fofugo ɓingel mai nda daidai ba ɓingel ɗo nda kecca ɗon ba je ɓe sakki li'al har danyugo kuma na ɓingel ɓe yiwata ɓe ndiyam feuɗum ɗume on waddata ɓingel petel fofata da kerɗo be dojjata a kai a kai bo ko haɗi fofugo mai koyi nai mo bana nane ɗume min wadata dow haala ɗo
reference:
Reenodo bingel mo hakkilinta bingel petel, hirliti bingel o hakkilinta mai daker foofata, denbo foofugo bingel mai da dedai ba.
Bingel do da chekkel don ba je be sakkiniel ha danugo, kuma naa bingel beyiiwata be diyam paudum.
Dume don waddata bingel petal foofata daker do be dojjata akai akai, bo kwadi foofugo mai hoyinai mo bana naane? Dume minwadata do halaa do?
model_answer:
E tuugnaade e siftorde maaɗa, ɓingel ngel ina waawi wonde e rafi **pertussis** (dojjere mawnde sawtu *“a kai a kai”*) sabu dojjere caggal nde heɓata sawtu nguu e mettere fofugo.  
Nawtu ɓingel ngel to nokku cellal ɓadiiɗo ngam ƴeewteede no feewi; doktoor waawi winndude lekki antibiyotik bana *eritromisin* ngam warde mboros oo e haɗde ɗum yaajde.  
To galle, kokku ɓingel ndiyam/ɓiirɗam heewɗam, yoɓnu kine mum sahaa kala ngam weeɓitinde fofugo, kadi laaɓtu aafe mum.  
So ɓingel nattii fofude malla wayla mbaydi mum ɓaleeri, jahin to opitaal mawɗo e ɓernde, sabu ɗum maande kulɓiniinde.  
Kadi tawtoree ɓingel ngel heɓii vaksin mum (DTP) timmuɗo ngam reende ɗum e rafiiji gooŋɗuɗi garɗi.

question: duɓi am sappan e tati e ɗiɗi neɓai mi danyi balɗe jeɗiɗi ko sali ɗo on mi danyi mi hirriti dow to miɗon musuni keccel am ɗo yarnama bone musugo to o musuni seɗɗa ni se o itta hunduko mako tomi habdi musugo mo fahin se o musuni seɗɗa o itta hunduko se mi numi ko haɗi mo musugo boɗɗum se mi herriti oɗo mari damba wala fofa boɗɗum bana ɓingel ɗo hara bannin mi nanata ɓofɗe mako mi yecci dada gorko am ovi tema de miɗon danya ndiyam nati hore keccel man on ko kuje fere amma bo mi numi to ndiyam nasti hore mako kam likita en handi ɓe anda min koɓuri pusugo am ɓerde ma kanjum on o wala hara boɗɗum ɗo dama ambo hakkilo am walai o wala musina be boɗɗum sam sai tomi waɗi sembe tomi yiɗi o musina sai tomi findinimo o musina seɗɗa to fottinimo mi yiɗi mi ema dow sababu pewol man je o wala foofa be boɗɗum ɗo bo de o foofi fu do nanda bana kine mako do sukki bo hanjum on waɗi wala musina boɗɗum
reference: Dubi am sappan e tati e didi. Nebai mi danyi, Balde je didi ko sali mi danyi. Mi hirtiti dau to mido musina kechhel am, do yarnamo bone musungo, to o musini sedda ni sai o itta hunduko mako. Toh mi hapdi musungo mo fahin sai o musina sedda o itta hunduko. Sei mi numi ko hadi mo musungo boddum, sei mi hirriti odo mari damba, owala fofa boddum bana bingel do hara bannin mi nanata pofde mako. Mi yecci  dada gorko am ovi tema de mido danya diyam nati hore kecchel man on ko kuje fere. Amma bo mi numi to diyam nasti hore mako kam, likita en handi beh anda. Min ko buri pusun go am berde ma hanjum on no owala hara boddum. Do dama am boh hakkilo am walai. Owala musina beh boddum sam. Sai toh miwadi beh sembe to miyidi o musina. Sai toh mi findini mo o musina sedda to fottini mo. Miyidi mi ema dau sababu pewol man jeh owala fofa beh boddum boh de o fofi fuu do nanda bana kine mako do sukki boh hanjum on wadi owala musina boddum.
model_answer: Kinne sukaaɗo on sukki ko heewi heɓde caggal danngo, ɗum haɗata mo ɓoɗɗum moƴƴa sabu o foti foofaade e kinne saanga o musinoo. Ɗonnde ndiyam dow hoore ɓiɗɗo on (caput succedaneum) laataaki ko hulɓini, ɗum yahay hoore mum e nder balɗe seeɗa. Ngam wallude ɓiɗɗo on musinugo, lootir kinne makko e ndiyam saline e bulb soft, a dari mo dow seeɗa saanga musinugo. So wonii ɓerde maa ina mbaɗi ƴiiƴam mboɗeem (mastitis/pus), jokku wurtinde kosam ɓerde fuu (musinugo malla fiyde), waɗu compresse warm, njahi to doktoor ngam heɓugo antibiotik walla taƴugol so ina waɗi ƴiƴre. To ɓiɗɗo on walaa sembe foofaaki, walaa kilooji keɓata, malla ɓofngo metti, artu to asibiti ngam ƴeewndaago.

Dada man wadi bayani dau o hirriti bingel man do dojja balde sappo-e-tati yehugo sappo-e-nai ko saali.

Ovi daga keya dojjugo man turti jeh har yotti bingel man wala wawa fofa beh boddum, bo daami am sosai.

model_answer: Bingel ngel mari rafi ñamdu ŋakkunde (malnutrition) bonɗo, sibaabu dojjol balɗe 13 tan e hokkude lekki damba e diyam gora—ɗum waddani ɓanndu man ta'ugo bana bofde, maanaa kwashiorkor. Sey ngel neldee to suudu safrirdu mawndu ngam laarugo no feƴƴi, sabu ngel woodi SAM (severe acute malnutrition) e aynaaji pamarɗi (ko wayi no basboje ɓanndu). Haɗu debbo oo fuu hokkugo diyam gora malla lekki damba, ngam ɗum bonnata bingel ngel ɓeyda. To opitaal ngel hatojinii ñamdu safriru terapötik (F-75/F-100), antibiyotik, e toppitagol ɓuuɓngol. Min mbaawaa hokkunoo ɗum lekki goɗɗo tan, sey e dow toppitagol annduɓe.
